record.rationale: Common browser profile storage replaces the native user/config/fontnameboxmruentries file. Actual localStorage denial follows the failed-file-open no-op boundary; unexpected errors remain visible. Real widget unmount and browser pagehide save actual current rows. Per-widget histories remain independent; no reactive global merge or C++ lifetime emulation is introduced.
